items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: And the only musician on there beside you and of course Stuff who really has any kind of a reputation was Jonah Jones.

ctx.x: Was he still with Alphonso Trent or was that later?

I think so, Alphonso Trent and then he had a little trio somewhere over at Toppy's there in Buffalo. He and Jonah and all them, I met Jonah at the same time. And I don't think he was with Alphonso Trent then.
Because that band broke up in Buffalo.
